title: Craft the PVP Items
description: This datapack allows you to craft useful PVP items.
body:
this data pack allows you to craft useful pvp items:
- trident
- totem of undying
- netherite upgrade smithing template
- leather horse armour
- iron horse armour
- notch apple (god apple)
- experiance bottle 
- enderpearl
- elytra
- crying obsidian
- cobweb
- full set of chainmail armour
If you wish to contact me about updating, or to suggest that i change or add a craft please message me on the following server https://discord.gg/Wc3tdXB7
